heading: Service of process
lead: The corporation shall comply with the law on service of process of each State in which it is incorporated and each State in which it carries on activities.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2071036:1904.June 1, 1982, Pub. L. 97–192, § 4, 96 Stat. 109. The words “in furtherance of its corporate purposes” are omitted as unnecessary.
